title: Provided That: Exact Conditions (amennyiben, feltéve, hogy)
grammar: Formal conditional conjunctions: amennyiben, feltéve, hogy, abban az esetben, ha
goal: I can formulate precise scientific and legal conditions using amennyiben and feltéve, hogy.
I can use abban az esetben, ha to isolate specific experimental scenarios.
I can discuss hypotheses, variables, and prerequisites in an academic register.

sections.title: Unit 7: Scientific Discovery & Hypothesis
body: Scientific and analytical Hungarian relies on tight logical links between assumptions, variables, and outcomes. Instead of everyday 'ha' (if), researchers and essayists frame exact prerequisites using 'amennyiben' (insofar as / provided that), 'feltéve, hogy' (assuming that), and 'abban az esetben, ha' (in the event that).

In this unit—inspired by Frigyes Karinthy's extraordinary autobiographical masterpiece Utazás a koponyám körül (1937), in which the writer observes his own brain tumor diagnosis and neurosurgery with the detached curiosity of a natural scientist—you will master proportional correlatives ('minél... annál...') and precision clauses for documenting phenomena.
